title: WB Chapter Test
subtitle: Chapter 11 접속사 (WB p. 86–87)
introKo: 이 연습은 [1–2] 2문항(고르기), [3] 1문항(고르기), [4–5] 2문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기), [6] 1문항(고르기), [7–8] 2문항(고르기), [9] 1문항(고르기), [10–12] 3문항(문장 전체 쓰기), [13–14] 2문항(고르기), [15] 1문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기)으로 되어 있어요.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [1–2] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: Julie ordered some food for delivery ________ she didn't want to cook.
choices: until
before
since
though
while

items.sectionInstructionKo: [1–2] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: We were not only sad ________ angry about the accident.
choices: and
but
or
nor
while

items.sectionInstructionKo: [3] 다음 중 문맥상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① Unless you aren't busy, please give me a hand.
② Tom called his girlfriend after he got on the bus.
③ Jina went home early until she had a lot of homework.
④ Cindy studied so hard for the test that she didn't get an A.
⑤ Since the Sun was shining brightly, it wasn't very warm.
choices: Unless you aren't busy, please give me a hand.
Tom called his girlfriend after he got on the bus.
Jina went home early until she had a lot of homework.
Cindy studied so hard for the test that she didn't get an A.
Since the Sun was shining brightly, it wasn't very warm.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [4–5] 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법상 알맞은 형태로 고쳐 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn: If there <u>will be</u> something wrong, I'll correct it.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [4–5] 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 어법상 알맞은 형태로 고쳐 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn: My uncle can't remember <u>when took he</u> the pictures.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [6] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 없는 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① I heard <u>that</u> you met Tim last night.
② They thought <u>that</u> the man was following them.
③ He believes <u>that</u> his son can be a great scientist.
④ I hope <u>that</u> we'll have a good time today.
⑤ We know <u>that</u> girl at the crosswalk.
choices: I heard that you met Tim last night.
They thought that the man was following them.
He believes that his son can be a great scientist.
I hope that we'll have a good time today.
We know that girl at the crosswalk.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [7–8] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• Speak louder, (A) nobody can hear you.
• Mix red and blue, (B) you'll get purple.
choices: and — or
or — or
or — and
or — but
but — and

items.sectionInstructionKo: [7–8] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• (A) you make a mistake, you'll win the first prize.
• They have lived there (B) we moved in.
choices: If — as
Unless — as
If — or
Unless — since
As — since

items.sectionInstructionKo: [9] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① <u>If</u> we save money, we can buy a new computer.
② I will take a picture with Mark <u>if</u> he comes to the party today.
③ You might not be able to sleep well <u>if</u> you watch a scary movie.
④ I couldn't tell <u>if</u> she was laughing or crying.
⑤ This game is easy to play <u>if</u> you know the rules.
choices: If we save money, we can buy a new computer.
I will take a picture with Mark if he comes to the party today.
You might not be able to sleep well if you watch a scary movie.
I couldn't tell if she was laughing or crying.
This game is easy to play if you know the rules.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [10–12] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
너뿐만 아니라 Andy도 장래에 작가가 되고 싶어 한다. (want, but also)
________ to be a writer in the future.
accept: Not only you but also Andy wants to be a writer in the future.
Not only you but also Andy wants

items.sectionInstructionKo: [10–12] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
보영이는 밤중에 너무 목이 말라서 잠에서 깼다. (wake up, thirsty, she, that)
Boyoung was ________ during the night.
accept: Boyoung was so thirsty that she woke up during the night.
so thirsty that she woke up

items.sectionInstructionKo: [10–12] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
시청이 어디인지 알려주시겠어요? (be, the city hall)
Could you tell me ________?
accept: Could you tell me where the city hall is?

items.sectionInstructionKo: [13–14] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① That he is only 14 is very surprising.
② She promised she wouldn't waste money.
③ I knew that he was upset about the news.
④ They forgot my birthday was disappointing.
⑤ The good news is that the weather will be nice tomorrow.
choices: That he is only 14 is very surprising.
She promised she wouldn't waste money.
I knew that he was upset about the news.
They forgot my birthday was disappointing.
The good news is that the weather will be nice tomorrow.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [13–14] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① I wonder if Nancy likes K-pop music.
② If you see Mina, please tell her to call me.
③ My father doesn't remember where he parked his car.
④ Unless you come in 10 minutes, we'll leave without you.
⑤ Do you think how old the woman is?
choices: I wonder if Nancy likes K-pop music.
If you see Mina, please tell her to call me.
My father doesn't remember where he parked his car.
Unless you come in 10 minutes, we'll leave without you.
Do you think how old the woman is?

items.sectionInstructionKo: [15] 다음 그림을 보고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 <조건>에 맞게 문장을 완성하세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn:
<조건>
• when과 because를 사용할 것 (단, 한 번씩만 쓸 것)
• 주어에 맞게 동사를 변형할 것
(1) The doorbell rang ________. (take a shower, I, be)
(2) ________, his teacher got angry. (break the window, he)
accept: when I was taking a shower|Because he broke the window
when I was taking a shower|because he broke the window
When I was taking a shower|Because he broke the window
